subject: OpenConflux steward onboarding — promo credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@openconflux.org>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Steward cohort — request for community credits and short trial extension

Hi Laura,

OpenConflux is running a "Steward Cohort" onboarding weekend (Aug 12–13) for 10 new open-source maintainers. We usually provide small compute stipends and token allowances so maintainers can prototype integrations and deploy demos.

Would Redwood be able to provide:
- 60k token credit pool (shareable across participants)
- 48 hours of sandbox GPU time (low-priority) for up to 3 projects
- A 60-day trial extension for accounts created during the cohort

Attached is our stewarding-plan (openconflux-steward-plan.pdf) with audience and expected outcomes. 

If this is possible, we can include Redwood in our sponsorship materials and run a short intro/demo during the cohort.

Thanks for considering,

Marta Lopez
Community Lead, OpenConflux
marta@openconflux.org

Attachment: openconflux-steward-plan.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Steward cohort — request for community credits and short trial extension

Looping in Marissa and Karthik — Marta's asking for credits and a short trial window. High upside for maintainers onboarding. My quick thinking:
- Approve 50k token pool (public promo), not necessarily 60k
- Offer 24h sandbox GPU per project (3 projects) to be safe on capacity
- Trial extension to 45 days

Can you weigh in on the budget/contract side? If we can approve I'll draft a promo code and allocation sheet. See attached steward plan for event timing.

On Fri, 20 Jul 2028 at 15:02, Marta Lopez <marta@openconflux.org> wrote:
> Hi Laura,
> 
> OpenConflux is running a "Steward Cohort" onboarding weekend (Aug 12–13) for 10 new open-source maintainers. ...

Thanks,
Laura

laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Steward cohort — request for community credits and short trial extension

Thanks Laura — I like the event visibility. We can support but need a narrow scope and finance sign-off.
Proposed final ask to send to OpenConflux:
- Promo credit: 50,000 tokens (single promo code: OC-STEWARD-28)
- Sandbox: 24 GPU hours per project (3 projects) on low-priority nodes
- Trial extension: 45 days for accounts created with the promo code
- Credits are only redeemable for public-facing maintainer projects (no contractor/paid services)

Ben — can you confirm budget & whether we need a finance approval ticket? I've attached a promo draft for legal/ops language (promo_draft.docx).

If Ben signs off I will draft the HubSpot sponsorship/opportunity and the DocuSign addendum.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Revenue Lead, Developer Relations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachment: promo_draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Steward cohort — request for community credits and short trial extension

Thumbs up from finance. Approve the following:
- Generate promo code: OC-STEWARD-28 — 50,000 tokens total, expiration 2028-10-15
- Allocate sandbox quota: 72 GPU hours total (24h x 3 projects) on low-priority pool; request quota ticket if provisioning needed
- Trial extension: 45 days attached to promo code

I've recorded this commitment in HubSpot (deal OC-2028-042) and added a revenue note. See allocation_sheet.csv for token accounting. No billing exposure expected; treat as promo expense.

Next steps for Laura/Marissa:
1) Send the promo code + steward acceptance email to Marta
2) Open quota ticket with infra (cc eng-ops) for the sandbox hours
3) Upload DocuSign addendum (I attached a link below)
